item.title: Anakeesta releases expansion details that will double the park’s footprint
item.description: Anakeesta, the mountaintop adventure park in the heart of the Great Smoky Mountains, unveiled Making More Magic, a five-year, $100 million investment for the largest expansion in the park’s history. It’s both a promise and a plan: to create new ways for guests to experience the beauty of the Smokies while enhancing every part of the Anakeesta adventure. item.title: Anakeesta End of January Construction Update | Anakeesta
item.description: In two weeks since our last Making More Magic construction project update, we’ve continued to make major progress. During this period, we achieved several milestones, including pouring large volumes of concrete, beginning construction of our return terminal structure, airlifting new towers by helicopter, and starting renovations at Firefly Village.

item.title: Making More Magic March Construction Update | Anakeesta
item.description: Over the past several weeks, the Making More Magic expansion has reached some of its most visible milestones yet. Phase 1 work on the Crystal Express gondola, a reimagined Firefly Village, and an expanded Treetop Skywalk is moving quickly. Alongside these updates, we’re also finalizing musical compositions and show designs for our new Firefly Experience.
